title: Clockshop curios and repair collection
notes: Original reusable orrery, watch cabinet, display plinth, spring winder, pendulum rack, timing diagrams, service shelves, oil/tool set, repair ledgers, packing crates, stools and cuckoo clocks. Model them deliberately; do not reuse generic low-quality presets. Add extensive room dressing and inspection text.

result.summary: Thirteen original reusable custom clockmaking models: orrery, watch cabinet, winding tool, rack, diagrams, ledgers, oils/tools, plinth, shelves, crates, stool and cuckoo clock. Normal world-art builds/audits and complete suite passed; native review reads all fourteen subjects and preserves them through Continue. Stock mechanisms are decorative until later quest rules.
